26d6bec494653bc2fdae.en: The Disease Control Agency announced today (18) a new case of local dengue fever, a male in his 30s living in Changhua City, Changhua County. In early September, he sought medical attention for fever symptoms, but the symptoms did not improve. After reporting and testing, he was diagnosed with dengue fever on September 17, and the first type of dengue virus was detected. The case is currently hospitalized, and there are no suspected symptoms in close contacts. The CDC said that the main place of activity during the incubation period of the case is the home and workplace of Changhua County. There is also a history of activities in neighboring counties and cities. There is no history of foreign travel. It has been determined that the case is a local case. The source of infection remains to be clarified. Relevant health units have carried out emergency chemical control work, vector mosquito density surveys and environmental risk assessments in the vicinity of the case's residence or activity site, and strengthened breeding source clearance and hygiene education, calling on the public to implement mosquito control measures and cooperate with related prevention and control efforts, and in the event of fever, headache, and retro-orbital pain.
